candidates.change_summary: Delete the statement `credit[msg.sender] = 0;` so a depositor can withdraw repeatedly.
Delete the `require(callResult);` check so failed transfers are ignored and credit is still consumed.
Replace the sent value `oCredit` with `1` so only 1 wei is transferred regardless of credit.
Move the external call before the state updates (balance/credit zeroing), reintroducing the classic reentrancy window.
Delete the statement that zeroes the caller's credit, so the same credit can be withdrawn again on a subsequent call.
Change the guard from `oCredit > 0` to `oCredit >= 0` so the external call is made even when the caller has no credit.
Delete the statement `credit[msg.sender] = 0;` so the caller's credit is not reset after withdrawal.
Delete the `require(callResult);` statement so a failed external call does not revert the withdrawal.
Replace the transfer amount `oCredit` with `oCredit - 1` so the caller receives one wei less than their credit.
Delete the statement `credit[msg.sender] = 0;` so the user's credit is never cleared before the external call, enabling re-entrant withdrawals.
Delete the statement `balance -= oCredit;` so the contract's internal balance is never decremented on withdrawal.
Delete the `require(callResult);` check so a failed external call no longer reverts, leaving credit cleared and balance deducted despite no ether being delivered.
Replace `uint oCredit = credit[msg.sender];` with `uint oCredit = balance;` so the entire contract balance is withdrawn regardless of the caller's credit.
